historical_references.reference: Harleena was a queen of the Mauryan Empire in ancient India, between the 4th and 2nd centuries BCE. She is best known for her role in the Jain texts, where she is portrayed as a devout Jain and a patron of Jain monks.

Harleena was also mentioned in the Hindu epic Mahabharata, where she is described as the wife of Bhishma Pitamaha and the mother of Vidura. The Mahabharata was likely compiled between 400 BCE and 200 CE.
